name: Cox's Bazar Beach Getaway
about: Stay beside the world's longest natural sea beach. Watch the sunset from Laboni Point, drive the Marine Drive to Himchari and Inani, and finish with fresh seafood at the beachfront. Hotel stay, breakfast and local transport included.

name: Saint Martin Island Escape
about: Cross the Bay of Bengal by ship to Bangladesh's only coral island. Walk the quiet beaches, see Chera Dwip at low tide, and enjoy a night under the stars. Ship tickets, resort stay and meals included.

name: Sundarbans Mangrove Cruise
about: Sleep on a river boat and explore the largest mangrove forest in the world. Visit Karamjal, Hiron Point and Katka with a forest guide, and look for spotted deer, crocodiles and, with luck, the Royal Bengal Tiger. All meals on board.

name: Sajek Valley Cloud Trip
about: Wake above the clouds in the Chittagong Hill Tracts. Visit Konglak Para, Ruilui Para and the Helipad viewpoint, and meet the Tripura, Pangkhua and Lushai communities. Cottage stay and jeep transport included.

name: Bandarban Nilgiri & Nilachal
about: Sunrise above a sea of clouds at Nilgiri, then the Nilachal viewpoint and the Golden Temple. A relaxed hill trip with local guides, chander gari (jeep) rides and resort stay.

name: Boga Lake Adventure Trek
about: Trek through hill villages to the high mountain lake of Boga. Camp near the water, share a bonfire dinner and return with a local guide. Suitable for first-time trekkers with average fitness.

name: Sylhet Tea Garden & Jaflong
about: Rolling tea estates at Malnicherra, the stone-bed Piyain river at Jaflong and the green hills at the Meghalaya border. Also includes the Shah Jalal shrine and Sylhet city food stops.

name: Ratargul Swamp Forest Day Trip
about: Paddle a small boat between the flooded trees of Bangladesh's only freshwater swamp forest. Best in the rainy season. Boat, guide and lunch included.

name: Tanguar Haor Boat Stay
about: Spend a night on a houseboat on the vast Tanguar wetland. Watch migratory birds, visit fishing villages and enjoy a sunset over still water. Meals and boat stay included.

name: Srimangal Tea Capital & Lawachara
about: Walk through Lawachara National Park to spot hoolock gibbons, then visit the tea gardens and taste the famous seven-layer tea. Resort stay and local transport included.

name: Rangamati Lake & Kaptai
about: Boat across Kaptai Lake to the Hanging Bridge, Shuvolong waterfall and tribal villages. Includes lake-view hotel stay and a speedboat ride.

name: Kuakata Sea Beach Retreat
about: See both sunrise and sunset from the same beach. Visit the Buddhist temple, Fatrar Char and the Lebur Char mangrove forest. Includes river ferry crossing and hotel stay.

name: Old Dhaka Heritage Walk
about: A guided day through Ahsan Manzil, Lalbagh Fort, Star Mosque and Armenian Church, with Old Dhaka street food on the way. Includes a rickshaw ride and lunch.

name: Bagerhat Mosque City Tour
about: Visit the UNESCO-listed Sixty Dome Mosque and the tomb of Khan Jahan Ali. Learn the history of the 15th-century mosque city with a local guide. Hotel stay and transport included.

name: Paharpur & Mahasthangarh Tour
about: Explore the ruins of the Somapura Mahavihara and the ancient city of Mahasthangarh. A calm history trip across two UNESCO-linked heritage sites in the north. Hotel and transport included.
